headline: Sensex and Nifty maintain bullish momentum amid IT sector buying and Q2 earnings expectations

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Nifty formed a bullish weekly candlestick with trade resistance identified around the 23,400-23,800 range.
Markets extended recent gains driven by heavy buying in IT stocks and strengthening of the Indian Rupee.
Investors are tracking key market triggers including FII flows, Q2 corporate results, and crude oil volatility.
Sensex surged over 1,500 points in recent sessions as broad market rally boosted investor sentiment.
whatHappening: Punjab National Bank set an income target of Rs 60,000 crore for the next few quarters.
Resolution professional for Reliance Communications filed a curative petition challenging the February Supreme Court spectrum ruling.
MeitY directed Meta to review its algorithms regarding misleading content and public order concerns.
Market focus for the week remains on the upcoming Reliance Jio IPO, FII trading activity, and quarterly earnings.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extended their rally supported by buying in IT equities and a stronger rupee. Investors are watching Q2 earnings, FII flows, and news surrounding the Reliance Jio IPO. PNB targeted Rs 60,000 crore in income while RCom RP filed a curative petition in the Supreme Court.
